metadata.question: Was snow present near the Mississippi River Delta Basin (Plaquemines-Balize Delta) during the interval of January 21-24, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Mississippi River Delta Basin (Plaquemines-Balize Delta) - roughly 29.3°N, 89.3°W - Date: January 21-24, 2025 - Collection: Sentinel-2 for optical snow detection, or MODIS Terra Daily Snow Cover - Snow is rare in Louisiana, so this is likely testing for a specific event 2. Masking strategy: - I should NOT mask clouds heavily since snow can be confused with clouds - Use MODIS Snow Cover product (MOD10A1) which has a specific snow band - Or use Sentinel-2 with NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) 3. Logic: - Valid detection of snow presence = A (Yes) - Valid detection of NO snow = B (No) - No images available = C1 - All pixels masked/invalid = C2 - Calculation failure = C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define the Mississippi River Delta Basin (Plaquemines-Balize Delta) const deltaPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-89.3, 29.3]); const deltaRegion = deltaPoint.buffer(50000); // 50km radius // 2. Date range const startDate = '2025-01-21'; const endDate = '2025-01-25'; // 3. Try MODIS Snow Cover first (most reliable for snow detection) let snowCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(deltaRegion); const collectionSize = await snowCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Snow images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No MODIS snow data available for this period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Get the snow cover data const snowComposite = snowCollection.max(); // 5. Calculate snow statistics const stats = await snowComposite.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs: true }).combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: deltaRegion, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const maxSnow = stats['NDSI_Snow_Cover_max']; const meanSnow = stats['NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean']; const pixelCount = stats['NDSI_Snow_Cover_count']; console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); console.log(`Max snow cover value: ${maxSnow}`); console.log(`Mean snow cover value: ${meanSnow !== null ? meanSnow.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`); // 6. Validation if (pixelCount === 0 || pixelCount === null) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (maxSnow === null || maxSnow === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 7. Snow detection logic // MODIS NDSI_Snow_Cover: 0-100 = snow cover %, 200 = missing data, 201 = no decision, // 211 = night, 237 = inland water, 239 = ocean, 250 = cloud, 254 = detector saturated, 255 = fill // Values 10-100 indicate snow presence (>10% snow cover) if (maxSnow >= 10 && maxSnow <= 100) { console.log(`Snow detected! Max snow cover: ${maxSnow}%`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`No snow detected. Max value: ${maxSnow} (likely water/cloud/no-snow)`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
